review:
117,649 ways and tumbles, mixed with collect symbols. A Collect on reel one or six grabs every money symbol on the grid, Super Collects add more money symbols to reels that already have some, and two collectors at once add a random 2x–10x multiplier.

Three to six scatters let you choose your bonus, like Random Wild Multipliers with 7–15 spins where each tumble adds 1x. The choice adds strategy. Up to 10,000x, 96.52% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
